title: Truce of Yam-Zapolsky
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Truce of Yam-Zapolsky", at revision 1340762338, opens: "The Truce or Treaty of Yam-Zapolsky (Ям-Запольский) or Jam Zapolski, signed on 15 January 1582 between the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and the Tsardom of Russia, was one of the treaties that ended the Livonian War. It followed the successful Livonian campaign of Stephen Báthory, culminating in the siege of Pskov." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1478267, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "peace treaty 1582 between Poland-Lithania and Russia". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
